item.title: Lollapalooza 2026: Highlight Performances From Zara Larsson, Tate McRae, Aespa & Jennie | All Access
item.description:
[Energetic music plays in the background]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're giving you an inside look at Lollapalooza 2026 in Chicago! I'm your host, Tetris Kelly.
[Music transitions to a lively tune]
Host: We're kicking off day one with a bang, and it's all about the performances. We caught up with some of the hottest stars, including Aespa, who brought the heat to the stage. But first, we started the day with a burning hot set from SB19, performing their new song "Lawless" for the very first time.
[Clip of SB19's interview plays]
SB19: It's the first time that we ever performed that song, and we just released that like a few hours ago... it's Lollapalooza, and there are lots of people watching, so had to move lawlessly.
Host: And the parties didn't stop there. Night one was all about the after-parties, with surprise performances from Lil Sims and Flavor Flav with Public Enemy at Soho House. We also caught electric sets from YUNGBLUD at Riviera Theater and Slayyyter at Salt.
[Music transitions to a smooth beat]
Host: Day two was just as exciting, with a morning chat with CORTIS at House of Blues. We also sat down with Whitney Whitney, who shared her journey to Lolla and overcoming her struggles with losing her voice.
[Clip of Whitney Whitney's interview plays]
Whitney Whitney: The process was the worst thing I've ever been through... but the fact that the timing and like the universe let me sing last week, and now my set is today, I don't know. Someone's working in my favor, and I am very excited.
Host: And that's a wrap from Lollapalooza 2026 in Chicago! With performances from Zara Larsson, Tate McRae, JENNIE, Aespa, and CORTIS, it was definitely a weekend to remember.
[Music fades out with a final voiceover]
Host: Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to watch the full video for even more behind-the-scenes action from Lollapalooza 2026!
